questions.question: Find the simple interest on ₹600 at 6% per annum for 4 years.

Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 42. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 42/7 = 6. Larger = 4 × 6 = 24.

questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/10 + 1/15 = 25/150. Time = 150/25 = 6 days.

questions.explanation: Difference = 4 parts = 32, so each part = 8. Smaller = 5 × 8 = 40.

questions.question: A boat travels 36 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 36/2 = 18 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 18 − 3 = 15 km/h.

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days and B in 4 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/4 = 16/48. Time = 48/16 = 3 days.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 28 days?
questions.explanation: 28 mod 7 = 0; Wednesday + 0 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 12th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 12th letter = L; 12 + 5 = 17th letter = Q.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (7, 343), (3, 27), (2, 6)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 2³ = 8, not 6.

questions.question: In a row of 25 students, Ravi is 14th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 25 − 14 + 1 = 12.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 7, 14, 24, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 16, so 37 + 16 = 53.

questions.question: If PEN is coded as QFO, how is TREE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1. Applying the same to TREE gives USFF.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.question: A person walks 5 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 11 + 3 × 3.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 11 × 3 − 3 = 33 − 3 = 30.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.question: Complete the series: H, L, P, T, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is X.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 13, 19, 17, 15
questions.explanation: 19, 13, 17 are prime numbers; 15 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 12th from the right end of the English alphabet?

questions.explanation: 38 mod 7 = 3; Tuesday + 3 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 7th to the right of the 14th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 14th letter = N; 14 + 7 = 21th letter = U.

questions.question: In a row of 50 students, Ravi is 6th from the left. What is his position from the right?

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ?

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 6, 14, 25, 39, ?

questions.question: If DOG is coded as GRJ, how is FISH coded?

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
